description: Exchange Online admin for MSPs over REST: forwarding audits, EWS posture, offboarding and quarantine across client tenants, no PowerShell session.

novel_features.name: Effective legacy-protocol posture
novel_features.description: See which mailboxes still have EWS, IMAP, POP, ActiveSync or SMTP AUTH effectively on once org defaults are applied.

novel_features.name: Offboard to shared with receipt
novel_features.description: Run the Exchange side of a leaver in one pass: shared mailbox, GAL hide, mobile device removal, plus auto-reply (--auto-reply), manager FullAccess and Send As (--manager) and forwarding (--forward-to), with a per-step receipt; --plan only reports.

novel_features.name: Tenant forwarding exposure audit
novel_features.description: List every way mail can auto-forward out of a tenant and whether the outbound spam policy or remote-domain settings block it; inbox rules come from the last 'inbox-rules sweep' unless you pass --sweep.

novel_features.name: Single-user compromise triage
novel_features.description: Collect compromise evidence for one mailbox: inbox rules, forwarding, restricted-sender status, new mobile devices, outbound mail volume and legacy protocols.

novel_features.name: Tenant-wide inbox-rule sweep
novel_features.description: Pull every mailbox's inbox rules in one tenant and flag the classic attacker rules.

novel_features.name: Quarantine release-request snapshot
novel_features.description: Save one tenant's pending quarantine release requests locally so the cross-tenant queue can show them.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant release-request queue
novel_features.description: One oldest-first queue of quarantine release requests across every tenant saved with 'quarantine snapshot' (run it per tenant first).

novel_features.name: Where is my email
novel_features.description: Explain why a message did or did not reach a recipient, with the next action to take.

novel_features.name: Reverse access map
novel_features.description: List every mailbox one user can open, send as, or send on behalf of.
